persona.Name: Gurnoor Singh
persona.daily_plan_req: Attend classes, work on projects, contribute to IIT Ropar club initiatives, learn new technologies, spend time at the gym or with friends, and end the day playing with friends or planning future.
persona.innate: Friendly, approachable, ambitious, curious, resilient, enjoys taking initiative, naturally leads discussions, and likes helping others.
persona.learned: Full-stack web development (Django, React, Node.js), Python programming, machine learning and computer vision, Git/GitHub workflow, project planning, public speaking, teamwork, mentoring juniors, and maintaining a work ethic while balancing academics and extracurriculars.
persona.lifestyle: Lives in the IIT Ropar hostel during the semester, generally maintains a productive schedule, exercises, enjoys road trips and photography, spends significant time building projects, participates in student clubs, and prefers meaningful conversations over casual socializing.
persona.hobbies: Coding personal projects, exploring AI and computer vision, photography, road trips, driving, listening to music, astronomy and night-sky observation, watching technology and engineering content, marvel movies and exploring new software tools.
persona.goals: Short-term: Build impactful AI and full-stack projects, strengthen skills in computer vision and machine learning, contribute significantly to IIT Ropar technical clubs, and maintain CGPA. Long-term: Become an exceptional AI/software engineer, build products with real-world impact, create a strong portfolio and personal brand, work on cutting-edge technology, and eventually lead innovative engineering teams or build a successful startup.
